roadConnectionCorroboration.retrieval: Full local news webpage opened via web READ connector.
roadConnectionCorroboration.factualScope: Reports a physical road connection between Aranyvölgyi út, the new roundabout, Vasmű út and Dózsa György út.
roadConnectionCorroboration.limitation: Transport topology corroboration only. It does not establish Vasmű út as a legal quarter boundary.

inferenceDecision.reason: The three named modern roads do not form a complete actual-node circuit. A conservative inside-road-face estimate follows the actual Vasmű út continuation and actual roundabout arc. Those specific edges are not stated in the quarter boundary text.
inferenceDecision.noClaimOfStreetRenaming: Vasmű is not silently renamed Aranyvölgyi; its separate modern name and unproven boundary role remain explicit.
inferenceDecision.alternatives: Opposite roundabout arc, other junction carriageways and an unavailable statutory R3 quarter line may differ. These remain unverified; do not invent a straight closing chord.
